particleScenarios.requires: Authoring commits spawn/lifetime to the source document; the component inspector commits playing/time_scale to its scene instance. Observe actual simulation/render changes and dirty state in the correct document; test a u64 seed above 2^53 without float conversion or high-bit loss.

Reject nonfinite, unsupported and field-specifically invalid values with source-located diagnostics; negative velocity/gravity/rotation remains valid. Source/scene policy must explicitly resolve existing runtime clamp/normalization differences, including zero-capacity validation; preserve last-good preview and document value.
Undo and redo restore actual source and preview values; reset applies the documented inherited/default value through one real transaction.
Observe advancing simulation/frame identity, frozen pause and stopped/reset behavior; no status-only success is allowed.

Verify deterministic seeded reset/rewind with bounded fixed steps, actual simulated age and particle state at time_scale 0, 0.5, 1 and 2. Distinguish requested unscaled seconds from scaled simulation age; universal CPU/GPU snapshot has no age, while GPU-specific instance age is not a universal clock. Unsupported warmup remains disabled with reason.

Save authoring source and scene instance through their actual owners, close and reopen; verify durable parameters, exact u64 seed, emitter/key identity and resource URI resolution. A save of an older revision must retain subsequent edits; save failure retains dirty state. Embedded asset copies are not claimed to have inherited-source synchronization.

Edit an actual normalized-lifetime key with stable identity, ordering and endpoint policy; preserve linear interpolation and size multiplier units. RGBA component curves share one source key/time and one undo transaction. Do not equate system seconds with a universal particle-lifetime playhead; CPU multi-key and GPU first-to-last baseline differences remain visible. Simulation changes and undo restores source and preview.

Edit supported VFX nodes and compile through compile_vfx_graph_program; show duplicate/unresolved/unsupported diagnostics. Niagara pins/edges and arbitrary scripts remain an explicit gap until implemented.

Verify E/Add Emitter only in the proper system mode, Space/Reset, Ctrl+O/collapse without opening a scene, Ctrl+S saving the active particle source, F/A graph fit without affecting the scene, context rename/delete and undo at the correct focus scope. Text input and popups own their local keys; disabled operations share the same eligibility across menu/button/shortcut. Missing emitter enable/isolation and clipboard schemas remain explicit gaps.
Open/close/dock/restore associated tabs and selection without destroying the shared document or duplicating runtime instances.
Distinguish requested/actual CPU/GPU execution, renderer admission and fallback using authoritative diagnostics and generation.

Make one supported real Penpot shared-style or local-variant edit, save/reopen/export/apply/load, and capture a corresponding actual screenshot change. Shared owner changes require Parent coordination.

Read actual same-instance simulation age in seconds; show normalized lifetime t0..1 independently, with no universal particle-lifetime cursor for mixed births/lifetimes. Do not display requested dt as actual age.

One horizontal gesture on shared RGBA key groups emitter/source-key before one domain mutation/inverse and four-channel reprojection. Vertical delta edits only the component. Linear/no tangent, finite HDR unclamped. Single-key API does not prove a multi-key atomic batch.

Preflight rejection has no side effect; Simulation error may follow tick side effects. Read actual clock only if original context remains valid, reject stale ACK/source/install/capability/request, preserve valid opener focus and shared Dock/Preview lifecycle. No production seek through old rewind.

Only native linked published Timeline/Curve/Transport with actual canonical source/codec/slots may mount. Current Space controls are not public slots; compose Stop/Reset with allowed standard Buttons under same context, no six-route remap or fake handler.

Render the actual five VfxGraphNode payloads, repeats/order and empty source using same-source/revision measured layout. Select and resolve only a current locator; reject old locator/layout on source/revision/reorder. Distinguish this read-only projection from actual editing, compiler/lowering, install and preview/frame readiness.
